thread:
alex: Quick thread  planning materials for next week's competitive push vs cloud AI platforms + infra vendors. Need: 1-pg battlecard, 30s SDR hooks, webinar one-pager, and a benchmark claim we can defend publicly.
jamie: Timeline check  deliverables by Tue noon so SDRs can prep Wed. Keep everything skimmable.
priya: For benchmark wording: use "typical customers" and cite workload (conversational mix, 1k req/s). Avoid absolutes.
tom: Webinar angle: "How to reduce production inference costs without sacrificing latency"  30-min technical + 15-min QA. Invite infra/platform leads.
morgan: SDR hooks (30s):
- Cost shock: "We help teams move from surprise bills to predictable spend with reserved pools + per-route metrics."
- Ops complexity: "One API that works across hosted, dedicated, and private  stop maintaining two stacks."
- Reliability: "Fallback policies keep apps serving degraded answers, not nothing."
sdr-lead: Also need escalation rubric for inbound routing (so SDRs know when to pass to AE):
- If they mention SLA, regulatory, or on-prem -> AE queue.
- If they ask for benchmark numbers or RFP -> Field research + demo request.
- If they ask pricing math for current month -> billing ops tag.
priya: Battlecard micro-structure suggestion: Header claim + 3 bullets (what we do, why it matters, quick evidence), 3 rebuttals, 2 discovery questions, 1 CTA.
alex: Draft sample rebuttal for cloud autoscale: "Autoscale helps throughput but increases variable spend and rarely includes per-route visibility. We offer reserved capacity with burst controls + per-route cost breakdowns."
jamie: For the public bench blurb propose: "Typical customers see 15-35% lower per-token cost after enabling batching and KV caching on mixed chat workloads." Footnote: "Based on internal analysis of sample customers at 1k-2k req/s."
priya: I'll vet numbers with infra team and add the footnote.
morgan: Visual idea for 1-pager: 3-column layout  Claim | Proof | Field line. I'll mock.
devrel-bot: Created template: https://redwood.company/drive/marketing/comp-battlecard-template (auto-upload).
alex: Ok let's freeze copy by Mon EOD. Jamie run SDR roleplay Tue AM. Priya to confirm bench and footnote. Tom to schedule webinar invites. I'll assemble final PDFs and upload to drive. :rocket:
